description.zh: 连接后可调用中金财富MCP工具，查询大盘行情分析、市场涨跌排行、实时行情动态、个股分析、条件选股、打新日历、基金分析、条件选基、ETF分析、热榜资讯、热点题材。
description.en: Once connected, you can call CICC Wealth Management MCP tools to query market-wide index analysis, gainers and losers rankings, real-time quotes, individual stock analysis, conditional stock screening, IPO calendar, fund analysis, conditional fund screening, ETF analysis, trending news, and hot themes.
